moments.title: EFL Championship Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season begins today, August 14th, with Wolverhampton Wanderers taking on Blackburn Rovers, marking the start of a new campaign for 24 clubs vying for Premier League promotion.

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's kick-off day in the Championship! Who are you backing for promotion this season? Wolves and Blackburn get us started tonight.

angles.name: Welsh Teams in Action
angles.copy: Our Welsh teams are back in Championship action this weekend! Wrexham face Cardiff City on Monday, while Swansea City are also in the mix. What are your predictions for the season ahead?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff this Sunday, August 16th, as Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup winners Manchester City.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Shield
angles.copy: The first silverware of the season is up for grabs this Sunday! Arsenal v Man City in the Community Shield, live from Cardiff. Who's lifting the trophy?

angles.name: Big Game in Wales
angles.copy: Principality Stadium is set for a massive clash this Sunday as Arsenal and Manchester City battle it out for the Community Shield right here in Cardiff! Are you heading to the game?

moments.title: Premier League Season Starts Next Week
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off next Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Premier League is Back
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns next Friday. Who's your pick for the title this season?

angles.name: Opening Fixtures
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Coventry City starts the Premier League next week! What's the standout fixture you're most excited for?

moments.title: Festival Season Continues: Reading & Leeds, Creamfields
moments.blurb: The final major festivals of the summer, Reading & Leeds and Creamfields, are just over a week away, running from August 27th to 30th, with huge line-ups announced.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Who's ready for Reading & Leeds or Creamfields next week? The summer festival season is almost at its peak!

angles.name: Last Big Bash
angles.copy: One week to go until Reading & Leeds and Creamfields! What's your must-see act on the line-up?

moments.title: Happy 75th Birthday, John Deacon!

angles.name: Another One Bites The Dust
angles.copy: The man behind some of Queen's biggest hits, John Deacon, will be 75 next week! Celebrate his birthday by cranking up a Queen classic.

angles.name: Golden God's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the legendary voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant, this August 20th! What's your ultimate Zeppelin anthem?

angles.name: Rock Icon Celebrates

moments.title: Happy 81st Birthday, Ian Gillan!

moments.title: Scottish Schools Head Back
moments.blurb: Many schools across Scotland are returning from their summer break this week, with some pupils already back in classrooms since early August.

source.l: Aberdeen City Council / Dundee City Council

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: It's back to school for many across Scotland this week! How was your summer break, and are you ready for the new term?

angles.name: Summer's Over (for some)
angles.copy: While some are still on holiday, Scottish schools are heading back! Wishing all pupils and teachers a great start to the new academic year.
